name: roottcostore.com
body: Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 3 front-end libraries have known flaws.
lesson: Check front-end library versions against a known-flaw list on every release, and upgrade the ones that are flagged.
summary: roottcostore.com scores 59 out of 100 (D). 6 checks fail now, 31 are at risk, and 26 pass. Fix first: 115 form controls have no label.

fix.title: 115 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /, /search, /products/rhbu-11085, /products/rhbu-11083 and 54 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: Links must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 66 elements on /, /pages/moving, /search, for example .t4s-site-nav__search > a[href$="search"][data-drawer-options="{ \"id\":\"#t4s-search-hidden\" }"][data-drawer-delay-="" and a[href$="account"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Give each link text, or an aria-label when it only holds an icon.

fix.title: 3 front-end libraries have known flaws
fix.evidence: swiper 11.1.11 (banner of https://cdn.shopify.com/extensions/01a1678d-9d7b-77b3-8022-2ba94c93ee07/hoppy-banners-76/assets/swiper.js): 1 known flaw, the worst rated critical, such as CVE-2026-27212. Swiper versions >=6.5.1 and <12.1.2 are vulnerable to…
fix.fix: Upgrade swiper to 12.1.2 or later; move jQuery off 7ab1a3a4.x, which gets no more fixes; upgrade DOMPurify to 3.4.16 or later. A major upgrade changes behavior, so retest the pages that use it.

fix.title: The viewport stops people from zooming
fix.evidence: The viewport tag sets user-scalable=no or maximum-scale=1.
fix.fix: Remove user-scalable=no and maximum-scale from the viewport tag.

fix.title: Buttons must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 1 element on /search, for example .t4s-search-form__connected-submit. Impact: critical.
fix.fix: Give each icon button visible text or an aria-label.

fix.title: Some pages are closed to AI answer crawlers
fix.evidence: OAI-SearchBot cannot read 1 page, ChatGPT-User cannot read 1 page, Claude-SearchBot cannot read 1 page, Claude-User cannot read 1 page.
fix.fix: Check that the closed paths are meant to stay out of AI answers.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
The start page arrived in 644 ms
Structured data parses and carries the expected properties
